BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled in the heart of the breathtaking Connemara countryside, Ballinafad Lodge is a charming detached dormer bungalow offering an enviable combination of tranquillity, comfort and spectacular natural beauty. Built in 1973 and presented in very good condition throughout, this bright and welcoming home enjoys uninterrupted mountain views and an idyllic setting in one of Ireland's most scenic locations.

Positioned directly opposite the Connemara Greenway, the property is perfectly placed for walking, cycling and enjoying the unspoilt landscape that has made this part of County Galway world-renowned. The prestigious Ballynahinch Castle Hotel, celebrated for its luxury accommodation, award-winning dining and salmon fishing, is located less than one mile from the property.

Ballinafad Lodge has been tastefully decorated throughout and offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation designed to maximise both comfort and the surrounding views. Extending to a floor area of circa 183.35 square meters, the heart of the home is a spacious open-plan living and dining room, featuring a beautiful natural stone fireplace with a solid fuel stove. The adjoining galley-style kitchen is both practical and efficient, while the stunning conservatory/sun room provides an exceptional space to unwind and appreciate the magnificent mountain. The accommodation is completed by four generously proportioned bedrooms and two well-appointed bathrooms.

This property enjoys an outstanding location in the heart of Connemara, an area renowned for its dramatic landscapes, lakes, mountains and outdoor pursuits. Clifden town is approximately 12 miles (19 km) away. Often referred to as the "Capital of Connemara", Clifden provides an excellent selection of supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, pubs, boutique shops, schools and healthcare services, together with a lively calendar of cultural and community events throughout the year.

The surrounding area is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts, with countless opportunities for walking, cycling, hiking, fishing and exploring the spectacular Connemara National Park, pristine beaches and scenic coastal drives. The property's position opposite the Connemara Greenway further enhances its appeal for those seeking an active lifestyle immersed in nature.
